mapper.select:
select , (select min(ri.id) from reader_interest ri where ri.member_id = m.id) as reader_interest_id, (select group_concat(ri.interest_name order by ri.id separator ',') from reader_interest ri where ri.member_id = m.id) as interests, rs.id as reader_settings_id, rs.personalization_enabled, rs.recommendation_notifications from member m left join reader_settings rs on rs.member_id = m.id
m.member_type = 'READER'
and exists ( select 1 from reader_interest ri_filter where ri_filter.member_id = m.id and ri_filter.id = #{member.readerInterestId} and ri_filter.interest_name like concat('%', #{member.interestName}, '%') )
and rs.id = #{member.readerSettingsId} and rs.personalization_enabled = #{member.personalizationEnabled} and rs.recommendation_notifications = #{member.recommendationNotificationsEnabled}
order by m.id desc
